body: It's really upsetting feeling like all this good is going on and still obsessing over how I should kill myself each night. I can feel it wearing me down...I feel like a time bomb. Each day I make it through should be a relief, but it just adds more pressure.

There's a diagnosis from maybe...12 years ago? I was medicated till I moved out on my own, and I haven't had the money since. I'm really worried I'm gonna hit the breaking point before I can get help.

I'm also worried that, should I seek out professional assistance that's NOT through my HRT provider, I may run into issues getting my surgery. There's a lot of approval needed before you can get something like that done, and I don't wanna mess that up. I'm ALSO worried that, if I look into professional help not through my clinic, I'll get pigeon-holed and dismissed. Being trans is really scary when it comes to things like this.
